evidence.quote:
We do not permit the use of Generative AI or AI-assisted tools to create or alter images in submitted manuscripts. This may include enhancing, obscuring, moving, removing, or introducing a specific feature within an image or figure. Adjustments of brightness, contrast, or colour balance are acceptable if and as long as they do not obscure or eliminate any information present in the original. Image forensics tools or specialised software might be applied to submitted manuscripts to identify suspected image irregularities. 
 The only exception is if the use of AI or AI-assisted tools is part of the research design or research methods (such as in AI-assisted imaging approaches to generate or interpret the underlying research data, for example in the field of biomedical imaging). If this is done, such use must be described in a reproducible manner in the methods section. This should include an explanation of how the AI or AI-assisted tools were used in the image creation or alteration process, and the name of the model or tool, version and extension numbers, and manufacturer. Authors should adhere to the AI software’s specific usage policies and ensure correct content attribution. Where applicable, authors could be asked to provide pre-AI-adjusted versions of images and/or the composite raw images used to create the final submitted versions, for editorial assessment.
evidence.title: Policy | International Journal of Asia Pacific Studies
evidence.location: Generative AI and images; complete research-method exception

coursework.en: The hosted KPT higher-education guideline advises ethical GenAI use under institutional rules; hosting it does not establish USM assessment permission.
coursework.zh: USM 托管的高教部指南建议按院校规则审慎、合乎伦理地使用生成式 AI；托管不等于 USM 已授予考核许可。
coursework.meaningEn: KPT national guidance hosted by USM CDAE; institution-specific coursework rules remain unverified.
coursework.meaningZh: 发布者为高教部，USM CDAE 为托管方；本校作业细则仍待核实。

exams.en: The 2024 discipline rules provide possible consequences for rule-8 examination offences; they do not establish an AI permission rule for every exam.
exams.zh: 2024 年纪律规则规定第 8 条考试违纪的可能后果，但不能据此确定每场考试的 AI 使用许可。
exams.meaningEn: Additional failing grades require Senate approval under rule 58(2); they are not automatic penalties for any AI use.
exams.meaningZh: 第 58(2) 条附加不及格处罚须获校务评议会批准，不是任何 AI 使用的自动处罚。

disclosure.en: IJAPS manuscript authors must disclose AI use in Materials and Methods, or Acknowledgments if that section is absent. A university-wide student format was not established.
disclosure.zh: IJAPS 作者须在材料与方法部分披露 AI 使用，无该部分时写入致谢；本次未核实全校学生统一格式。
disclosure.meaningEn: IJAPS publication scope only; do not apply this journal rule to all coursework.
disclosure.meaningZh: 仅适用于 IJAPS 投稿，不能推广到全部课程作业。

privacy_data.en: These sources do not establish a current USM-wide classification of data that may be entered into GenAI tools.
privacy_data.zh: 这些来源不足以确定当前 USM 全校可输入生成式 AI 的数据分类规则。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Journal authorship rules and a hosted national guide do not supply institutional data approval.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 期刊署名政策和托管的国家指南不能替代学校数据批准。

approved_tools.en: No university-wide institutional tool entitlement was established by this source set. Mentioning ChatGPT in a journal policy is not a licence or assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: 本来源集合未核实全校机构工具资格；期刊提及 ChatGPT 不等于提供许可证或授予考核许可。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Account, eligibility and cost remain unknown.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 账户、资格及费用仍未知。

research_publication.en: IJAPS and Kajian Malaysia limit AI-assisted writing to readability and language improvement; authors remain responsible. IJAPS prohibits AI authorship and AI-created or altered manuscript images, with a research-method exception.
research_publication.zh: IJAPS 和 Kajian Malaysia 将 AI 辅助写作限定为改善可读性和语言，作者仍负责任；IJAPS 禁止 AI 署名及生成或修改投稿图像，研究方法用途另有例外。
research_publication.meaningEn: Journal-specific submission rules, including the full research-design exception; not a USM-wide thesis or coursework policy.
research_publication.meaningZh: 期刊投稿专用规则，须保留研究设计例外完整条件；不是 USM 全校学位论文或作业政策。

academic_integrity.en: The 2024 student discipline rules took effect on 4 November 2024. Rule 67 allows an appeal within fourteen days of receipt of the decision; procedure-specific conditions remain relevant.
academic_integrity.zh: 2024 年学生纪律规则于 2024 年 11 月 4 日生效；第 67 条允许在收到决定后十四日内申诉，仍须遵守对应程序条件。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: General student discipline, not an AI-specific automatic sanction; rules 67–69 distinguish appeal submission and committee decision periods.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 一般学生纪律程序，不是 AI 专属自动处罚；第 67–69 条区分申诉提出期限与委员会裁决期限。

teaching_guidance.en: KPT recommends institutions develop GenAI policies for teaching, research and scholarly writing. The hosted document does not prove USM has adopted every recommendation.
teaching_guidance.zh: 高教部建议院校制定教学、研究及学术写作的生成式 AI 政策；托管文件不证明 USM 已采纳所有建议。
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 面向高等院校的国家层面建议。

security_procurement.en: A USM-specific security or procurement approval workflow was not established from the reviewed public sources.
security_procurement.zh: 本次公开来源尚不足以核实 USM 专属的安全或采购审批流程。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Do not treat a hosted national recommendation or a journal tool example as institutional approval.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 不能将托管国家建议或期刊工具示例视为学校批准。

scope.en: The concrete disclosure and authorship actions below apply to IJAPS manuscripts, not all USM student assessments.
scope.zh: 下列具体披露和署名行动仅适用于 IJAPS 稿件，不是全部 USM 学生考核规则。

do.en: For IJAPS submissions, disclose AI use in the specified manuscript section.
do.zh: 向 IJAPS 投稿时，按要求在稿件指定部分披露 AI 使用。

dont.en: Do not list AI as an IJAPS manuscript author.
dont.zh: 不得将 AI 列为 IJAPS 稿件作者。
